A can fill oil tank in 14 hour

7 units of tank (half) filled by A in 7 hours

questions.q_en: If sec⁴x + 4 = 5 sec²x, then find the value of tan x
questions.q_hi: यदि sec⁴x + 4 = 5 sec²x है, तो tan x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
options_en:
1 , √3

√3, - √3

2, √3

2 , 1/√3
options_hi:
1 , √3

√3, - √3

2, √3

2 , 1/√3
questions.solution_en:
Let Sec² x = y

y² + 4 = 5y

y² - 5y + 4 = 0

y² - 4y - y + 4 = 0

y(y - 4) - 1(y - 4) = 0

(y - 4)(y - 1) = 0

⇒ y = 4, 1

Sec² x = 4 (using an identity)

1 + tan² x = 4 (∵ Sec² x - tan² x = 1)

tan² x = 3

tan x = ±√3
questions.solution_hi:
माना Sec² x = y

Sec² x = 4 (एक पहचान का उपयोग करके)

1 + tan² x = 4 (∵ Sec² x - tan² x = 1)

tan² x = 3

tan x = ±√3

questions.q_en: Jehangir had to cover a distance of 90 km in an hour. During the first 25 minutes travelled at a speed of 15.2 metres per second. How many metres did Jehangir cover per second during the remaining period to reach his destination on time?

32.5
32

questions.solution_en:
Distance = 90km = 90000 m
Time =1h = 3600sec
Formula
Distance = speed × Time
Time spent = 25min = 25 × 60 = 1500sec
Distance covered in 25min
= 15.2 × 1500
= 22800m
Remaining Distance = 90000 - 22800
= 67200m
Remaining Time =3600 - 1500
= 2100sec
= 67200m/2100s = 32m/s

दूरी = 90 किमी = 90000 मीटर

25 मिनट में तय की गई दूरी
= 15.2 × 1500
= 22800 मीटर
शेष दूरी = 90000 - 22800

questions.q_en: A circle is entirely enclosed within a parallelogram such that all four sides of the parallelogram are tangent to the circle. What particular type of parallelogram must this be?
questions.q_hi: एक वृत्त पूरी तरह से एक समांतर चतुर्भुज के भीतर इस प्रकार घिरा हुआ है कि समांतर चतुर्भुज की चारों भुजाएँ वृत्त को स्पर्श करती हैं। यह समांतर चतुर्भुज किस विशेष प्रकार का होना चाहिए?
options_en:
Rectangle

Trapezoid

Square

Rhombus
options_hi:
आयत

चतुर्भुज

वर्ग

समचतुर्भुज
questions.solution_en:
A circle can be inscribed within a parallelogram (meaning it is tangent to all four sides) only if the parallelogram is a tangential quadrilateral.

In tangential quadrilateral, sum of opposite sides are equal.

AB+CD= BC +DA

CAB=CD and BC=DA

opposite side of parallelogram are equal

2 (AB)=2(BC)

⇒ AB = BC

Thus, a parallelogram with adjacent sides equal is a Rhombus.
questions.solution_hi:
किसी समांतर चतुर्भुज के अंदर एक वृत्त तभी बनाया जा सकता है (यानी वह चारों भुजाओं को स्पर्श करता हो) जब वह समांतर चतुर्भुज एक स्पर्शरेखीय चतुर्भुज हो।

स्पर्शरेखीय चतुर्भुज में, सम्मुख भुजाओं का योग बराबर होता है।

AB + CD = BC + DA

AB = CD और BC = DA

समांतर चतुर्भुज की सम्मुख भुजाएँ बराबर होती हैं।

2 (AB) = 2 (BC)

⇒ AB = BC

अतः, जिस समांतर चतुर्भुज की आसन्न भुजाएँ बराबर होती हैं, वह एक समचतुर्भुज (Rhombus) होता है।

questions.q_en: Two candidates P and Q contested in an election. 70% of the registered voters are P supporters. If 60% of the P supporters and 30% of the Q supporters are expected to vote for candidate P, then what percentage of the registered voters are expected to vote for candidate P?

Let total votes = 100

= 42 + 9 = 51 = ×100=51%

questions.q_en: If the cubic equation a³-4a²+5a-2=0 has the roots x, y, z then find the value of x + y + z.

options_en: 5
6
7
4
options_hi: 5
6
7
4
questions.solution_en:
General equation form = Aa³+Ba²+Ca+D=0
comparing with =a³-4a²+5a-2=0
A=1, B=-4, C=5, d=-2
Sum of roots =-B/A
x +y + z= -(-4)/1=4.
questions.solution_hi:
सामान्य समीकरण का रूप = Aa³+Ba²+Ca+D=0

तुलना करने पर =a³-4a²+5a-2=0

A=1, B=-4, C=5, d=-2

मूलों का योग =-B/A

x +y + z= -(-4)/1=4
